free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: the target only needs q_len != 1 so that the q_len==1 early return is skipped; the flag decision is independent of sequence length

free_parameters.name: batch
free_parameters.why: batch size does not enter the target condition; one batch keeps the CPU run small

free_parameters.name: heads
free_parameters.why: head count does not enter the target condition; head_id is selected explicitly

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: hidden width is irrelevant to the branch decision; 16 is a valid attention head width

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: needed to look up best_pattern below the target; zero is the natural first head

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed makes the random q/k/v tensors identical across repeats and replays

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU-friendly floating dtype; the branch decision does not inspect tensor values
